newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indosat selects adviser for Satelindo sale.
newsitem.headline: Indosat selects adviser for Satelindo sale.

text.p: Indonesian telecommunications firm PT Indonesian Satellite Corporation (Indosat) said on Wednesday it was selecting valuation advisers for the firm's proposed sale of its stake in telecommunications firm PT Satelit Palapa Indonesia (Satelindo).
"We are now selecting advisers for valuation," president director Tjahjono Soerjodibroto told analysts.

Soerjodibroto said state-controlled Indosat, also listed in New York would initially offer to sell a 6.5 percent stake out of its total holding of 7.5 percent in Satelindo to other existing Satelindo shareholders.

Satelindo's other shareholders included Deutsche Telekom's DeTeMobil, PT Bimagraha Telekomindo controlled by President Suharto's son Bambang Trihatmojo and state-controlled PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom).
Soerjodibroto said Indosat would offer the stake to other parties should the existing shareholders were not interested.
He said the share sale was expected to be finalised later this year.
